alternatives.mustBeRow: declare the size as (1,:) or call validateattributes(x, {'numeric'}, {'row'})
alternatives.mustBeColumn: declare the size as (:,1) or call validateattributes(x, {'numeric'}, {'column'})
alternatives.mustBeMatrix: declare the size as (:,:) or call validateattributes(x, {'numeric'}, {'2d'})
alternatives.metafunction: use nargin/nargout, or parse the file with mtree
